answer: One concrete defense: anchor each agent to the physical power-draw waveform of the machine it runs on, sampled by a trusted smart meter that emits a periodic beacon. Honest hosts spread across a wide canyon of distinct energy signatures; a flock of clones packed onto one rig collapses into a single jade-tinted waveform, so the network merges them into one voice. Forging N signatures means buying N real machines, and that linear hardware cost starves the swarm.
